Methodology

My Design Process

A structured, repeatable framework that transforms complex user problems into elegant, intuitive digital solutions.

01

Discover & Research

Conducting stakeholder interviews, user surveys, competitor audits, and behavioral data analysis.

Phase 1 of 5
02

Define the Problem

Synthesizing research data into explicit user personas, journey maps, and architectural requirements.

Phase 2 of 5
03

Ideate & Explore

Sketching rapid wireframes, exploring multiple layout hypotheses, and establishing information hierarchy.

Phase 3 of 5
04

Design & Prototype

Creating high-fidelity UI components, interactive prototypes, and scalable design token systems in Figma.

Phase 4 of 5
05

Test & Improve

Running usability testing sessions, accessibility audits (WCAG), and continuous post-launch refinement.

Phase 5 of 5
